item.title: A message from Mr. Warner.
item.description: Anyone interested in trying out for junior or senior girls' basketball should sign up in the gym foyer. Junior girls' tryouts are today after school and Friday September 4th after school. Senior girls' tryouts are Wednesday September 9th and Friday September 11th after school. Please message Mr. Warner on Teams if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Ms. Brennan
item.description: Attention, adventurers! The Dungeons & Dragons Club will be running again this year on Tuesdays and Thursdays at lunch in Room 201. Returning players are welcome, and new players are encouraged to join—whether you’re ready to roll your first character or just curious to see what D&D is all about!
